# Draft:Six Kingdoms Publishing

----
= Six Kingdoms Publishing =
Six Kingdoms Publishing is an independent British publishing house established in 2024 and based in Manchester, England. The company publishes fiction and non-fiction across multiple genres, with a growing catalogue that includes fantasy, psychological thriller, and historical narrative works.
History
Six Kingdoms Publishing was founded in Manchester in 2024. The publisher released its first title in November 2024, marking its entry into the competitive UK publishing market. Since its inception, the company has focused on developing new literary voices and producing thought-provoking content that spans various genres.
Publications
Fiction
The publisher's debut release was "The Shadow Weaver" (11 November 2024.), the first instalment in the "Beyond the Glassway" fantasy adventure series by British author David J. Mumford. The book is available in both softcover and ebook. The series is ongoing, with Mumford currently working on the sequel titled "The Dream Thief".
Additionally, Mumford is developing an untitled psychological thriller with themes of isolation and redemption under the Six Kingdoms imprint. On 25 April 2025, a post was published on the publisher's Creators Hub, giving a teaser of this work.
Non-Fiction
Six Kingdoms is expanding into historical non-fiction with the forthcoming release "Shadows Over Japan: Silence, Denial, and Shame" (2025), which explores controversial and often overlooked aspects of Japanese history. The book examines sensitive historical topics including the Kanto Massacre, Unit 731, and the Nanjing Massacre, addressing their impact on modern Japanese identity and international relations.
Publishing Philosophy
Six Kingdoms Publishing has positioned itself as a platform for both established and emerging writers, with an emphasis on character-driven storytelling across all genres. The publisher demonstrates a willingness to engage with challenging subject matter, as evidenced by their upcoming historical narrative on controversial aspects of Japanese history.
Creators Hub
A distinctive feature of Six Kingdoms Publishing is its "Creators Hub", an online resource on the company's website that provides writing tips, publisher updates, and exclusive content previews. The hub serves as a community resource for writers and readers alike, fostering direct engagement between the publisher and its audience.
On 18 April 2025, the Creators Hub announced the upcoming release "Shadows Over Japan: Silence, Denial, and Shame" in a post titled "Behind the Scenes: Exploring Japan's Shadows". The book is available for pre-order from 1 May 2025
